_notes: Scaled setup: solvers are scored on the 73 Maros-Meszaros problems the reproduced Python solver can hold as dense arrays (n <= 1000, dense data <= 2 GB), split 37 train / 36 test, under an evaluator-enforced 120 CPU-second budget per instance. The held-out test uses evaluator-generated perturbations of its problems (two hidden draws each) and a hidden family of 36 generated degenerate QPs. Success is decided by the evaluator's own KKT check of the returned primal-dual point, never by solver-reported status. Paper values below are the paper's own numbers (C++ ODYN, 103-problem subset, 120 s wall-clock limit) and are not targets the gym must match. Coefficients are magnitudes; direction comes from higher_is_better.

failure_rate_comparison.description: Failure rate on Maros-Meszaros QPs at medium (1e-6) and high (1e-9) requested accuracy (paper Table III). Every instance of the fixed manifest is in the denominator; an instance is solved only if the evaluator verifies the returned (x, y, z).

failure_rate_medium.description: Percentage of manifest instances without a verified 1e-6 solution (missing, crashed, over budget, or failing the KKT check).

failure_rate_high.description: Percentage of manifest instances without a verified 1e-9 solution; catches methods that only work at loose tolerances.

failure_rate_comparison._setup_note: Paper: 103 Maros-Meszaros problems (failure counts 10/103 medium and 16/103 high for ODYN), C++ solvers, 120 s wall-clock limit. Gym: 37/36 tractable problems per slice, Python reference, 120 CPU-s budget, evaluator-verified success; the test slice scores two hidden perturbations per problem.

degenerate_problems.description: Failure rate on degenerate QPs (redundant active inequalities, LICQ failure with rank-deficient and badly scaled data, positive-semidefinite Hessians with non-unique solutions) at medium and high accuracy (paper Table IV categories).

degenerate_failure_rate_medium.description: Percentage of degenerate instances without a verified 1e-6 solution.

degenerate_failure_rate_high.description: Percentage of degenerate instances without a verified 1e-9 solution.

degenerate_problems._setup_note: Paper values are derived from Table IV: the share of its three degenerate problems a solver did not solve (OSQP declared the LICQ-failure problem dual infeasible; every other solver solved all three; the accuracy setting is not stated, so only the medium metric is filled). The paper reports iteration counts, which the gym does not score because a method's own iteration count cannot be verified. The gym scores the paper's three problems (train / paper-level) and a generated family of the same three categories (12 instances each, n in {8, 16, 32, 64}; the test family uses a hidden seed).
